items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Amos got the bass player, Lou Morrow, who lives out that way... and we brought Stash O'Loughlin... Alan Hanlon on guitar... we had quite a show.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

jam-packed and Amos got the bass player, Lou Morrow, who lives out that way and Rudy Walker, a drummer who lives out that way and we brought Stash O'Loughlin, a piano player, Alan Hanlon on guitar. Alan and Flo Hanlon are members of the House that Jazz Built. Flo sings, and so we had quite a show.
Florence sang, the bass players wife, Lynn Morrow, she sang, Estella Williams, one of our members, sang and we had Carmen Leggio -- Wilma De Ric our secretary brought Carmen Leggio and his wife.
